ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LQT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the u day of April, 2026, by and between Pedro Lopez, having an address at 2019 Valentine Avenue, Bronx, New York 10457 ("Owner"), and 299 East Burnside LLC, having an address at 635 Guion Drive, Mamaroneck, NY 10543 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, being 2019 Valentine Avenue, Bronx, NY (BBL: 3149, 185) on the Tax Map of the City of New "Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, being 299 E Burnside Ave, Bronx, NY (BBL: 3149, 1) on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer Land", said building and improvements, together with any future replacements "Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (each, a “New Developer Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Developnent Rights”(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the“Retained Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the“Excess Development Rights");
